LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Every fan believes they could do it differently. In FM27, belief isn’t a hot take, it’s a story waiting to happen. 

Pick the team. Define your style. Spot what other managers might miss. Maybe you need a ball-playing defender to break the lines. Maybe you lose your star striker to injury. 

Secure the talent you need for that title charge. Then train your team to work as one. 
 
Drill your ball progression, fine-tune your defensive block, and set your sights on what comes next. 

Match day. 

React to everything the opposition throws at you. Beat their press. Fill the box. And throw the kitchen sink. Because every decision could be the one to change everything.  

So chase the vision only you can see. Whatever happens, you’ll remember the calls that got you there. 

FM27 Console. Make The Call.  

What’s new for FM27 Console? 
- Immerse yourself in the managerial journey with refined layouts that make use of every inch of space, putting the big calls front and centre.  
- Fully customisable Controller Mapping puts more power in your hands, so you can tailor your setup to your gameplan. 
- Find that attacking midfielder to fill the gap in your side thanks to more intelligent Recruitment, while live reactions offer valuable insight to secure the deal during contract negotiations.  
- Elevate your training approach for crucial fixtures ahead with all-new Match Preparation. Now you can set priorities straight from your inbox, whether you're gearing up for an Out of Possession masterclass or practicing finishing in the final third for a must-win. 
- Respond to whatever match day throws at you with the arrival of Tactical Tweaks, delivering greater influence direct from the touchline. 
- Experience every fixture as a richer piece of football theatre thanks to upgrades to crowds, stadiums and match day environments that elevate the stage for your players to perform. 


*This version contains information that is still under approval process by right holders and may contain data that does not, at this time, accurately reflect real world data. For context, some club and player assets may be absent during this version.
